stages.discovery: A stone watchtower crowns the rise ahead, built to see three roads at once and standing empty on all three counts. A signal brazier on the roof has gone cold, and a length of rope still hangs from the flag mount - no banner on it, not even a scrap of one.

choices.label: Climb to the Signal Roof
choices.description: See how far the view carries
choices.outcome: From the top you can trace all three roads to where they vanish into treeline, exactly what this tower was built for. Whoever manned it could have seen trouble coming from any direction - which makes its emptiness harder to explain, not easier.

choices.label: Search the Watch Room
choices.description: Supplies might still be stored below - Investigation check

check.success_outcome: The lower room has been picked over once already, but you find a locked chest tucked under the stair that held out against whoever came through before you. Inside: coin, and a coil of good rope.
check.failure_outcome: You go through the watch room but whoever came through before you was thorough - there's nothing left worth carrying.

choices.label: Keep to the Road
choices.description: ESC also cancels - the tower isn't going anywhere
choices.outcome: You leave the tower unclimbed and its cold brazier behind you.
